Research & Professional Experience

USYD & The Australian Institute of Marine Science (AIMS)

Technical Skills & Certifications

Field & Survey Techniques

  • Marine Fish Surveys: Underwater Visual Census (UVC), Unbaited Remote Underwater Video (RUVs / stereo-RUVs), eDNA sampling.
  • Benthic Surveys: Photogrammetry, photo-quadrat surveys, coral sampling & tagging.
  • Scientific Diving: PADI Rescue Diver (338+ logged dives).

Laboratory & Analytical Skills

  • Molecular: Fish eDNA metabarcoding, DNA extraction, PCR, capillary electrophoresis.
  • Biochemical: Lipid extraction & fatty acid analysis (GC-MS), stable isotope analysis (DELTA V Advantage), protein & chlorophyll extraction.
  • Morphological: Otolith extraction and fish specimen fixation.

Data Analysis & Computational Tools

  • Statistical Analysis & Visualization: Advanced modeling in R (e.g., GLMMs, piecewiseSEM).
  • Video & Image Annotation: EventMeasure (SeaGIS), CoralNet, CPCe.
  • Bioinformatics: Phylogenetic tree construction (CIPRES, MEGA).

Licenses & Certifications

  • Class C Driver License (NSW, Australia & Taiwan)
  • General Boat License (NSW, Australia)
  • First Aid, CPR, Advanced Resuscitation, and Oxygen Therapy
